hooks.hook_text: ShipBob’s new Simulation Terminal lets merchants run full‑cycle fulfillment, receiving, and inventory adjustments in sandbox without touching real stock.
hooks.rationale: The role of Test is unknown, but anyone responsible for integration testing would value a sandbox that eliminates risk to live inventory.
hooks.bridge: Our platform can automatically match the simulated operations data with finance records and surface any mismatches before the system goes live.

hooks.hook_text: In the Spring 2026 release, ShipBob announced delivery‑date guarantees, trusted tracking, and AI that can ship orders in days.
hooks.rationale: The role of Test is unknown; these new promises affect both the financial side (cost of guarantees) and operational side (delivery execution).
hooks.bridge: By reconciling promised delivery dates with actual financial outcomes, our solution surfaces exceptions when costs exceed expectations.

hooks.hook_text: ShipBob just launched the first Anthropic‑verified fulfillment connector, extending its AI suite.
hooks.rationale: The role of Test is unknown, but AI‑driven fulfillment creates new data flows between operations and finance that need alignment.
hooks.bridge: Our system can ingest the connector’s data, match it to accounting entries, and highlight any discrepancies across the two domains.

hooks.hook_text: ShipBob reported a 2024 estimated ARR of $97.7 M and a $1 B valuation.
hooks.rationale: The role of Test is unknown; the scale of the business suggests complex finance‑ops integration challenges.
hooks.bridge: Our platform helps enterprises of this size keep finance and operations data synchronized, surfacing exceptions that could impact reported ARR.
